verdict.rationale: doola documents a first-party Formation MCP server that lets a founder form a Wyoming LLC from their own AI client, so natural-language operation through an AI assistant is a real product capability. Its documented scope is narrow: one formation type in one state, with no evidence of natural-language control over compliance, EIN, registered agent or other workflows. missing for 10: natural-language coverage beyond Wyoming LLC formation, documentation of supported commands/tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: the doola Formation MCP server, which lets a founder form a Wyoming LLC from their own AI client with their own doola account.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.doola.com/skill.md
